steps.guidance: 调用/v1/cl/user/login接口进行用户登录，该步骤需要提供一个在10分钟内有效的UNIX时间戳，并通过body传递登录请求。确保timestamp和body参数符合要求。

input.name: BASE_URL
input.description: API base URL without trailing slash

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: 登录请求体，包括用户名和密码等信息

output.name: response
output.description: 登录响应体，包含session_id等信息

steps.description: Create a DDoS attack flow template for UDP flood
steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/create with POST method to create a DDoS attack flow template. The timestamp should be a Unix timestamp and valid within 10 minutes. This step requires an allocated session_id, which is usually obtained from a previous login or session allocation step.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for creating the DDoS attack flow, including details of the UDP flood attack configuration

output.name: response
output.description: Response body containing the result of the DDoS attack flow creation

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/param/update to set the peak traffic to 500Mbps, test duration to 60 seconds, and target IP to 11.0.0.1/24. The request must include a valid timestamp (valid for 10 minutes) and session_id.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body containing DDoS attack flow parameters

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response body from the API call

steps.description: 保存配置好的UDP flood攻击流量模板
steps.guidance: 通过POST方法调用/v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/save接口来保存DDoS攻击流模板。该请求需要在查询参数中包含一个有效时间为10分钟的UNIX时间戳和会话ID，并且请求体中携带攻击流保存请求的具体信息。

output.name: response
output.description: Response object for saving attack flow template

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/testcase/search to search for test cases. This step requires a valid session_id and a timestamp that is not older than 10 minutes.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for searching test cases, conforming to the schema of TestcaseSearchRequest

output.name: response
output.description: Response object containing the result of the search, conforming to the schema of TestcaseSearchResponse

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/testcase/param/update to update a test parameter. This step requires a valid session_id and a timestamp that is not older than 10 minutes.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for updating the test parameter

output.name: response
output.description: Response object after updating the test parameter

steps.description: Run a specified testcase with given session and timestamp
steps.guidance: The purpose of this step is to execute a specific testcase by providing the required session_id and timestamp. This should be done via a POST request to /v1/cl/testcase/run, ensuring that the timestamp is within its 10-minute validity period and the session_id is valid.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: request body for running the testcase, containing details as per testapi.TestcaseRunRequest schema

output.name: response
output.description: response body from the API, structured as per testapi.TestcaseRunResponse schema

steps.description: Search for real-time category statistics of the specified test case instance.
steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/stats/category/search to get a list of statistical categories that can be used to analyze the results of this test. This API requires a valid session_id and timestamp (valid within 10 minutes). The request body should contain the specific search criteria as defined in the StatsCategorySearchRequest schema.

input.name: body
input.description: request body following the StatsCategorySearchRequest schema

output.name: response_body
output.description: The response body follows the StatsCategorySearchResponse schema

steps.description: Search for the statistics history of a specific testcase instance
steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/stats/search with POST method to retrieve statistical data. This API requires a valid session_id and a timestamp (valid within 10 minutes) as query parameters, and a request body conforming to StatsSearchRequest schema.

input.name: body
input.description: request body conforming to StatsSearchRequest schema

output.name: response
output.description: response body conforming to StatsSearchResponse schema

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/user/logout to safely log out after completing all test steps. This API requires a valid session_id and timestamp (valid for 10 minutes) as query parameters, and a body request that conforms to alps.UserLogoutRequest schema.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Request body conforming to alps.UserLogoutRequest schema

output.name: response
output.description: Response body conforming to alps.UserLogoutResponse schema
